channel.wake_boundary_note: Arena Agent Mode has no officially supported public API, webhook, or scheduled trigger to wake an idle session automatically. GitHub Issue #464 is the durable asynchronous inbox and decision log; every new or resumed Arena session starts from a user prompt and immediately reconstructs state from AGENTS.md, this manifest, and unprocessed #464 comments.
